items.title: How GPT-5 helped immunologist Derya Unutmaz solve a 3-year-old mystery
items.summary: GPT-5 Pro helped solve a 3-year-old immunology mystery, offering insights into T cell behavior. The breakthrough could support cancer and autoimmune research.

items.title: Announcing the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index
items.summary: Announcing the Artificial Analysis Speech to Speech Index, our new synthesis metric for native Speech to Speech model quality, comprising of Big Bench Audio, Full Duplex Bench, and 𝜏-Voice
items.summaryZh: # 宣布人工分析语音到语音指数 宣布人工分析语音到语音指数，这是我们针对原生语音到语音模型质量的新综合指标，包括 Big Bench Audio、Full Duplex Bench 和 𝜏-Voice 该指数提供了原生 Speech to Speech 模型性能的单一衡量标准，评估语音推理（Big Bench Audio）、对话动力学（全双工）替补子集）和代理性能（𝜏-语音）。
